root_cause_analysis.symptom: Two argparse flags (--merge-days, --merge-slots) exist where one automatic behavior suffices. Future agents could use the wrong flag causing silent data loss.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Cycle 1 added --merge-slots as an additive fix (backward-compatible). The two-flag design was intentional for that cycle but creates ongoing complexity risk. User has now approved removing both flags and making slot-level merge the sole automatic path.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — this is intentional simplification building on Cycle 1 (no commit yet, changes are staged)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 1 BA spec (ba-spec-20260416-172720) preserved --merge-days for backward compatibility with timeline/transportation/budget agents
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Two paths = two ways to get it wrong. Any new agent prompt must choose the right flag. merge_agent_slots() produces correct results for complete-day payloads too (dict.update with all keys = replacement), making --merge-days redundant.
